names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 aprilie, «Sfântul Apostol Irodion».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Ηρωδίων ο Απόστολος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 8 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. апостоли Иродион, Агав, Руф, Асинкрит, Флегонт и Ермије.“, where Св. апостоли heads the whole company of six and belongs to no one of them, so each forename stands bare. The heading gives him no epithet and no see.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: His own page names four days: «Prăznuirea lui se face la 4 ianuarie împreună cu cei 70 de Apostoli, la 28 martie, 8 aprilie și la 10 noiembrie.» 8 aprilie is the day the Romanian calendar prints him on and the only one held here.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 aprilie — «Sfântul Apostol Irodion»

feast.note: The Greek calendar keeps him on 28 March, which is one of the four days his own Romanian page names; the Romanian row on this folder holds 8 April, the day doxologia.ro prints him on. saint.gr's page adds «Η μνήμη του Αγίου Ηρωδίωνα επαναλαμβάνεται στις 10 Nοεμβρίου», his memory is repeated on 10 November. One row per church is the schema, so the Greek row records the Greek day page that was read and the November day is noted here.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Ηρωδίων ο Απόστολος»

attestations.note: The page makes him one of the Seventy, a fellow worker of the Twelve and of Peter especially, and bishop of Patras after the martyrdom of Andrew the First-called; it has him seized by Jews and idolaters, beaten savagely, stoned, and finally butchered in the crudest way. The apolytikion it prints under his name calls him instead the luminary and shepherd of Hypata — the Thessalian town whose three saints saint.gr keeps together — and not of Patras; the hymn names Herodion and no other saint, so it is taken as his and copied, and the disagreement with the page's own prose is recorded here rather than mended.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.04.2026 (8. април ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли Иродион, Агав, Руф, Асинкрит, Флегонт и Ермије.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry is **an enumerated company of six**, and the heading names all six, so it is six rows and not one: Иродион, Агав, Руф, Асинкрит, Флегонт, Ермије. All six are folders the corpus already keeps and all six already relate to one another, so there is no new folder. The Prologue keeps the company on the Julian 8 April, the same menologion day the Romanian keeps all six on; the Greek keeps this man on 28 March and Hermes on 8 March, and neither was moved. The man is the same beyond doubt: of the Seventy, Paul's kinsman by Romans 16, 11, bishop of Neopatras, beaten over the head with staves, struck on the mouth with stones and stabbed with knives, left for dead and rising to serve the apostles again, and beheaded at Rome on the day Peter was crucified. **A second witness for the Romanian see.** The Prologue makes him bishop of **Neopatras**, as doxologia's life does, where saint.gr's prose makes him bishop of Patras after Andrew and its own apolytikion calls him the shepherd of Hypata — a disagreement this folder already records and does not mend; the Prologue now stands with the Romanian reading, which is worth the author's eye but changes nothing here. The Prologue names no Olympas with him, saying only «са многим другим хришћанима», with many other Christians. No year anywhere in the entry, and this folder has none. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Apostoli Irodion, Agav, Ruf, Flegon, Asincrit şi Ermis, Glasul 3

english.text: O holy apostles, pray the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of sins.

hymns.text: Τῆς Ὑπάτης φωστῆρα καί ποιμένα θεόληπτον, τοῦ Παρακλήτου σέ χάρις, Ἠρῳδίων ἀνέδειξεν ἐν ταύτῃ γάρ Ἀπόστολε τό φῶς ἐκήρυξας τό θεῖον τοῦ Χριστοῦ, καί ὡδήγησας πρός πίστιν τήν ἀληθήν τούς εὐσεβῶς βοῶντάς σοι δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ χορηγοῦντι διά σοῦ, ἡμῖν τά κρείττονα.

source.text: saint.gr — Άγιος Ηρωδίων ο Απόστολος, Ἀπολυτίκιον. The page prints no tone for it. Its «Τῆς Ὑπάτης» does not agree with the same page's prose, which makes him bishop of Patras. Recorded with kind troparion, which is the schema's word for it.

english.text: The grace of the Comforter showed you forth, Herodion, as the luminary of Hypata and its God-possessed shepherd; for in that place, O Apostle, you preached the divine light of Christ, and guided to the true faith those who devoutly cry to you: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who through you bestows on us the better things.
